en.p1: Source home is a device that energises and polarises your space. Its goal is to keep the energy of the people in it at the highest level, in spaces full of modern technology. Source home works as a valve: it draws all positive ions and dirty electricity into the ground and, at the same time, spreads electrons into the space and balances the field around itself with the help of the earth's mass. You can describe Source home as a vacuum ion pump that filters the energy of your space for you, without a break.
en.p2: Users report more energy, good sleep, better distribution of energy, fewer highs and lows in energy, a calmer state and stimulated brain activity.
en.p3: The device uses an inverse method to change the energy structure of a space. This sets it apart from other devices that aim for the same effect: it does not disturb our abilities and does not load our morphological field while it works.
en.note: The effects listed are user experiences and are not medically proven.
en.q: If EMF were an unpleasant smell, Home would be a window you can open anywhere in your flat to clear the air. Similar devices mask the situation, like spraying air freshener over a bad smell. The real fix is a draught that replaces the air, or in this case the energy. That is what Home does: it changes the energy values of your space.
en.q2: That is why we call it inverse technology. It is the opposite of technologies that spread rays (vibration) outward, because that approach raises questions about how devices affect us as very sensitive living beings. After all the devices we already have around us, we do not need one more source of interference.
en.open: Source home — a generator and leveller of energy that relieves the Ether potential in your space, and a generator of the earth's green energy that brings free electrons into your space. It removes all the negative effects of technogenic and geopathogenic radiation that act on us, and makes our biological oscillators synchronise and settle, and our energy with them. Working 24/7, it is one of the few devices that reduces the build-up of the effects of Wi-Fi router radiation …
en.torusAlt: Toroidal field around the Source home device: inflow at the top, outflow at the bottom, core connected to the ground.
en.torus: Testing the pulse, that is the field of our device, the inflow and outflow of the torus. Through its vortex field, Home draws in and neutralises ions of the opposite charge to its core. At the same time it spreads negative ions into the space until the Ether potential in your home levels with the potential of the core, which is the ground. Then it holds that level. The device works for you 24/7 without by-products, because its inverse method leads harmful free radicals into the largest capacitor there is: the earth.
en.kon: Under the coil sits the sandwich wall of the capsule, 9 mm thick in total, which withstands up to 5 bar of pressure. That property of the device body is not crucial for us. What matters is that the centre of the wall is made of glass fibre. This lets us collect ions and guide them in the chosen direction through the core of the device, where every positive ion is neutralised on contact with the copper core inside the capsule. The core is connected directly to the ground, so its capacity to absorb positive ions and release electrons into the space is unlimited.
en.only: This is the only technology on the market that relies on the natural law of levelling the potential between two spaces.
en.emf: The device draws positive ions out of the space and puts electrons into it, with no stored waste and no by-products. It exchanges the energy of the space and balances the Ether potential in it.
en.l1: Place the device where you need it: a work space or a rest space.
en.l2: Spaces larger than 120 m² need 2 devices.
en.l3: Source home has no fixed lifetime. You switch it off like any other device.
en.klima: To make it easier to understand: the effect is similar to an air conditioner, but the technology is completely different. It uses different resources and a different method to change the energy state of a space.
en.t1: Take a small compass and switch Source home on. Bring the compass to the edge of the lower or upper cap of the device and rest it on something next to the device. You will see the needle vibrate, like a clock hand with a flat battery: one step back, one step forward, but staying in place. The result can depend on how the compass is built, how sensitive the needle is and how big the compass is.
en.t3: After you switch it on, the device reaches full working potential in 3 minutes. Since it works for you around the clock, this warm-up time does not matter in daily use.
en.price: SOURCE HOME — free electrons brought from the earth straight into your space. Levels the basic Ether potential of your space and, through it, of your body. Neutralises the effects of EMF. Neutralises geopathogenic effects in the space. 30% more vital energy, higher productivity, deeper creativity, stronger will, continuous energy. Use: it works in your space for you 24/7, with no effort or willpower from you. (Details in the brochure.)

en.body: Assessment formula: Google Home, Gemini smart devices, 1 router, 2 routers, 1 router + 2 extenders, is your space a duplex? Ceiling height, room volume, and the time you spend in each part of the space during the day. All of this is essential for calculating the load on your space. It lets us work out the cumulative and absorbed radiation in your space, which is also the main way devices affect us through the space.
en.box: A mistake you can't undo: less than 2.5 m of open space between the Wi-Fi router and your body is a problem no device can solve. The only fix is to do less: move the router.

en.quote: Our biggest project, Ether pill, started in 2022, has finally come to fruition. I am happy with the test results […] The goal of the project was and remains "Elixir water". I put all my knowledge into one whole, respecting every property of photons and electrons, of water as a carrier of information, and of the ways we can drink it […] My bioelectronic mushroom has finally seen the light of day. We will present the final product, with all data, photos and videos, on our profile.
en.cell: The Ether photo cell connects light and water under controlled conditions. It is an orgone cell with an output: copper winding without an end, and a magnetic field around a graphite nanotube core, all set in resin with a special magnifying shape. Its output leads into the water in a glass. The accumulated light energy stays trapped in the salt water as information, and for some time after the cell is removed from the glass, a higher energy charge can still be recorded.
